2122135949094350967.en_summary: Elon Musk reveals he recruited SpaceX’s first engineers by telling them 'we’re probably going to die', and ended up as chief engineer because no good one would join. Started in mid-2002 expecting 90% chance of failing, to get people to Mars.
2122135949094350967.zh_summary: 埃隆·馬斯克透露他招募SpaceX首批工程師時告訴他們「我們可能會死」，並因無人願意加入而成為首席工程師。2002年中開始，預期失敗機率90%，目標是送人上火星。

2122135556784328777.en_summary: Quotes Ming-Chi Kuo estimates of 12M units for OpenAI and 14M for Anthropic in 2028-29 for Google TPUs, and shipment estimates 8-9M/14-15M/16-18M for 2027-29, calling it 'Holy smoke'. Shipments growing in 2029 despite expected AI capex peak in 2028.
2122135556784328777.zh_summary: 引用郭明錫估計OpenAI 12M台、Anthropic 14M台（2028-29年）谷歌TPU，以及2027-29年出貨估計8-9M/14-15M/16-18M，並稱「Holy smoke」。盡管預期AI資本支出2028年達峰，2029年出貨仍增長。

2122135189245792704.en_summary: The damage is already happening, great news for NVDA competitors!
2122135189245792704.zh_summary: 損害已經發生，對NVDA競爭對手來說是好消息！

ticker_notes.NVDA: Jensen相關負面消息已造成損害

2122134319800238297.en_summary: The entire “good for America” argument is that in the near term, Jensen’s downfall may create more distance between American and Chinese AI capabilities. Even if true, not obviously good for America. Just good for two companies. References NYT opinion that Jensen Huang’s Fall Is Bad for Nvidia but Good for America.
2122134319800238297.zh_summary: 整個「對美國有利」的論點是短期內Jensen的下台可能拉大中美AI能力差距。即使屬實，也不顯然對美國有利，只是對兩家公司有利。引用紐約時報觀點認為Jensen黃的下台對英偉達不利但對美國有利。

2122133641484468655.en_summary: We'll see how this sorts out. Not a China hawk, avoids language about illegally selling chips to China. Interesting to see what US intelligence has and board response with activist interest. Nvidia wants to sell chips to China for market share anyway. Possible lying to board and relationship with subordinate adds complications.
2122133641484468655.zh_summary: 看看這件事如何發展。不是中國鷹派，避免使用非法向中國出售芯片的語言。有趣的是看美國情報有什麼以及董事會如何應對激進投資者。英偉達無論如何都想向中國出售芯片以獲取市場份額。可能對董事會撒謊及與下屬的關係增加了複雜性。
